summary.text: Cal Warwas is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 7B who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A miner, he faces Democrat Dan Horoshak in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Cal Warwas was born in Virginia, Minnesota, and his career experience includes working as a miner.
He earned a degree from Mesabi Range Community and Technical College in 1999.

Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as Steelworkers Local 1938, the Clinton Township Board, the St. Louis County Association of Townships, the Minnesota Association of Townships, Better In Our Back Yard (BIOBY), the Iron Mining Association, and Mining Minnesota.
Warwas won the August 2024 Republican primary for District 7B over Matt Matasich and the November 2024 general election over Lorrie Janatopoulos, and he took office on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy and House Taxes committees.
